visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit studio setting, five people are gathered around a wooden table. A man in a white chef-style outfit is gesturing and talking to a woman in a blue denim jacket. The background features a YouTube award trophy, a clapperboard, and shelves. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot of a man in a blue striped shirt and a woman with long reddish-brown hair; the man holds a smartphone and speaks with an earnest expression. (3) A graphic title card with the text '愛開黃腔的聊天' appears against a light blue and green background. (4) The group returns to the studio table; the man in white continues his monologue, prompting the others to burst into laughter with wide smiles and clapping. (5) Three individuals—two men and a woman—are shown in a medium shot discussing something technical. The man on the left wears a blue jacket and listens intently. (6) A new scene shows four people seated at a dining table filled with plates of food. They are actively using chopsticks to eat while engaging in a lively, humorous conversation. (7) Close-up on the dining table participants as they react with laughter and disbelief to a joke. The woman on the right covers her mouth while laughing.
